caseName: Watts v. Arizona ex rel. Burgoon
caseNameFull: Cornelius C. Watts v. State of Arizona at the Relation, etc., of Ignatius Burgoon, Treasurer, etc.
summary: Error to the Supreme Court of the State of Arizona.
attorneys: Mr. S. L. Kingan and Mr. Joseph W. Bailey, with whom Mr. Herbert Noble, Mr. Hartwell P. Heath and Mr. Conrad H. Syme were on the brief, for plaintiffs in error., Mr. Leslie C. Hardy, with whom Mr. W. J. Galbraith was on the brief, for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Section 237 of the Judicial Code, as amended by the Act of September 6, 1916, c. 448, § 2, 39 Stat. 726; Jett Bros. Distilling Co. v. Carrollton, 252 U. S. 1, 5-6.

Mr. Leslie C. Hardy, with whom Mr. W. J. Galbraith was on the brief, for defendant in error.
